description: This Java class provides helper functions for testing Akka persistence journal in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically for 'things' persistence. It interacts with in-memory Akka persistence query APIs to fetch journal events related to ThingId objects.

classes.name: ThingsJournalTestHelper
classes.description: A generic helper class for testing Akka persistence journal related to 'things'. It retrieves events from an in-memory journal based on ThingId and maps them to domain objects.

methods.name: ThingsJournalTestHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the helper with ActorSystem, journal entry to domain object converter, and domain ID to persistence ID mapper.

methods.name: getAllEvents
methods.description: Fetches all domain events for a given ThingId by querying the in-memory journal.

methods.name: getAllEventEnvelopes
methods.description: Retrieves raw event envelopes for a specific persistence ID.

methods.name: convertEventEnvelopeToDomainObject
methods.description: Converts an EventEnvelope to a domain object using the provided mapping function.

methods.name: runBlockingWithReturn
methods.description: Executes an Akka Source stream and collects results into a List, with a timeout.
